note: H3 vendor governance. These three third-party libraries ship VENDORED under renderer/lib/ (outside npm), loaded from disk only — no CDN at runtime (see docs/r3-data-and-privacy.md 'Network egress'). Each is pinned by sha256; scripts/check-supply-chain.js fails closed if a file's hash drifts from this manifest. All three are permissive-licensed (MIT). Update policy: bump only via a reviewed PR that updates version + sha256 here in lockstep and re-runs the vulnerability audit.

libraries.name: alpinejs
libraries.versionEvidence: embedded `version:"3.14.8"` string in the minified source
libraries.updatePolicy: reviewed PR only; bump version+sha256 in lockstep; re-run vulnerability audit
libraries.vulnerabilityAudit: npm advisory DB lookup for alpinejs@3.14.8 (no known advisories as of the H3 build); re-checked on each version bump
